utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Hana, do we have the confirmed start time yet, and should a few of us come early to set up tables and keep the entrance clear?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’m still confirming the exact start time, Pia, so don’t treat it as final yet. I’ll also check whether early setup is needed and let you know who should come before we ask anyone to head over.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Hana — I’ll hold off telling anyone a time until you confirm. If you do need early help, I’m happy to come by and make sure there’s space for the larger repairs.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Hey Leo, glad I caught you—Noah mentioned he’s waiting on the address and repair list, so send those along when you can and I’ll get my tools ready.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Will do — I’ll send the address and repair list over shortly. Rosa’s still confirming a couple item details, but I’ll keep you posted.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Thanks, Leo — once you send it over, I’ll sort through my garage and bring whatever tools match the list.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hi Vik — I’m asking around today for the repair drive, mostly to see if anyone can spare folding tables or tool kits for Saturday late morning.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’m still waiting on Cleo to confirm the final time and tool list, but I’ll pass along your ask for folding tables and tool kits as soon as I have the details.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Thanks, Vik — that’s perfect. I’ll keep nudging folks on my end, and if Cleo sends you the final list, I can help spread it around quickly.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Hi Uli — we’re keeping the repair drive to safety fixes for now, like railings, lighting, and leaks. The weekend timing isn’t final yet, so I’ll share the exact time once Rosa and I finish checking the closet.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Cleo — I’ll wait for the time, then quietly ask around for tool kits and pass along that it’s safety fixes only.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: That sounds perfect, Uli—please keep it low-key until I confirm the time with Rosa. Tool kits are helpful, but for now make sure folks know we’re only taking safety repair supplies.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Bo, the repair drive’s coming together nicely — Opal’s sorting stations, and the main needs I’ve heard are extension cords, work gloves, labeled parts bins, and a few basic hand tools.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it — I can round up cords, gloves, and some bins, but remind me: are we locked for Saturday and what hours should I tell folks?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I don’t want to give you the wrong time — Hana was double-checking the start hours, so I’ll confirm with her and loop you in as soon as I hear.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Hi Rey, I’m still piecing together the repair drive details from everyone—have you heard whether the date or repair list is confirmed yet?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Not yet, Nell—I’ve mostly heard that Eli and Oren are involved, but I’m still waiting on a clear list and date before I can promise time.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Rey — I’ll treat that as still unconfirmed, then. I’m going to wait for Eli, Oren, or Jules to pin down the date and repair list before I pass anything along.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hey Eli, I’m helping with the repair drive and can bring my basic tools and some spare hardware—do you know what else is needed?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Sam—bring those basics, and let’s put you on the fence repair unless you’d rather handle the front step. I’m keeping Saturday the 18th, nine to noon, and I’ll send the final list once Lila’s piece is confirmed.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Fence repair works for me, Eli—I’ll plan on Saturday the 18th from nine to noon with my basic tools and spare hardware, and I’ll wait for your final list.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Faye, I’m likely joining late Sunday at the community center, but Rosa’s got me down to help—do you know what repairs still need coverage?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Dane — I’m still waiting on the confirmed repairs list from Rosa/Hana, but I’ll mark you as late Sunday at the community center and plug you into whatever coverage is still short.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Perfect, thanks Faye — just point me at the short-staffed stuff when I get there, and I’ll bring whatever tools Rosa or Hana confirm.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely, Opal—I’ll check my block as I invite folks and note who still needs pickup help versus who’s already covered.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Perfect, Quinn—thank you. If you can send me the house numbers or names by Friday evening, I’ll fold them into the pickup map.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely—I’ll send you the house numbers and names by Friday evening. I’ll keep tracking which homes still need help as I spread the invite.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Noah, I’m catching folks up as I go—Sam and Lila are in, and we still need one more helper for the fence, leaky gutter, and broken porch step.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh—right, thanks Ira. I can be that extra pair of hands, just remind me what time Leo settled on so I don’t wander in late.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Noah—that’s perfect. I haven’t heard Leo’s confirmed time yet, but I’ll let you know as soon as it comes through so you don’t miss it.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hi Mina — we’re aiming for Saturday late morning into early afternoon, and I’m still lining up table setup plus a couple more repair volunteers.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Good — who’s already confirmed for repairs, and how many folding tables do you still need for Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Opal’s helping, and Gus said he can bring tools and pitch in once the list is set; I’m still waiting on a couple repair volunteers. For tables, I’m trying to lock down enough for setup now, so if you know who can spare folding tables for Saturday, send them my way.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Oren, before I send anyone your way, can you confirm whether the repair drive is definitely this Saturday and if we’re only accepting safety repair supplies for now?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, Kira, I think it’s meant to be this Saturday, but please don’t quote me until Hana confirms it. And yes, safest thing is to tell folks we’re only taking safety repair supplies for now.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Thanks, Oren—that’s helpful, but I’ll hold off calling Saturday definite until Hana confirms. For now I’ll only mention safety repair supplies if anyone asks.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Rosa, I’m hearing the repair drive’s planned for Saturday late morning into early afternoon, and I’m asking around for folding tables and tool kits in case they still need extras.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Tess — quick update, the repair drive has moved to Sunday at the community center, so tables and tool kits would still be a big help there.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh! Sunday at the community center, got it — I’ll correct that with folks and keep rounding up folding tables and tool kits.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Oren, do you have the repair drive date confirmed yet, and what jobs still need volunteers or supplies?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, Mina, I’m sorry—I don’t think I’ve got the date confirmed in my head yet. I can help gather tools and point folks toward fixes once someone gives me the definite time and list.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Alright, thanks—please start a quick list of tools you can gather, and I’ll send you the confirmed time and repair list once Cleo locks them down.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Gus, do you know who’s handling intake? I’m just worried people will arrive all at once and nobody will know where to put things.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I think Noah and Eli are still sorting the list, Pia, but that’s a good point — I can ask them to make sure someone’s set up at the front to tag things as folks arrive.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Gus—maybe ask them to bring extra tags or tape too, just in case. If intake backs up, even a little labeling table could save a lot of confusion.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Ira, I’m still waiting on Rosa to confirm the exact time, so don’t treat Saturday as final yet. For now we’re only collecting safety repair supplies—things for railings, lighting, and leaks.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Got it, Cleo — I won’t call Saturday final yet, and I’ll only mention safety supplies for railings, lighting, and leaks while I’m passing the word around.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Ira — that helps. Once Rosa confirms the time and I finish the closet count, I’ll send you the exact tool list to share.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Mara, it sounds like Opal’s got the stations underway, and Hana’s checking the start time and tools—do you know what gaps still need covering so I can point Dane and anyone else the right way?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Yes — I still need help with table setup and a couple more repair volunteers. If Dane or anyone else can jump in there, that would be a big help.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Perfect, thanks Mara — I’ll point Dane toward table setup first, and I’ll ask around for a couple more repair volunteers too.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hey Noah, I’m helping Kira with the repair drive and I’m bringing basic tools plus any spare hardware I can find—do you want to pitch in too?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right, the repair drive — yeah, I do want to pitch in. I’m still waiting on Leo for the exact details, but I can bring myself and whatever odd tools I’ve got.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: That sounds great, Noah — bring whatever odd tools you’ve got, and once Leo or Kira shares the exact details I’ll help make sure we’re all on the same page.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sounds good — I’ll come by late with my work gloves and a few basic hand tools.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Great, thanks, Dane — I’ll note you for late support. If you know any homes on your block still needing help, send me the addresses and I’ll map them in.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Will do — I’ll ask around my block and send you any addresses I hear about.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Hi Rey — I’m still confirming the repair drive details, but the penciled-in time is Saturday the 18th from nine to noon, and I’ll only pass the tools list once it’s definite.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks — Saturday the 18th from nine to noon works for me. Just let me know when it’s definite and what tools to bring.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Will do — I’m checking the final tools list now, and I’ll send it over as soon as it’s confirmed.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Hey Faye, I’m a little fuzzy on the latest—can you remind me what pickup times you want covered and I’ll help get the sign-up organized?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Bo — can you set up slots around 8:30–9:30 after drop-off and 3:00–4:30 before pickup for now? I’m still waiting on Hana to confirm the final start time and tools list.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yep, I’ll put in 8:30–9:30 after drop-off and 3:00–4:30 before pickup for now. Just send me Hana’s final start time and tools list when you get them.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Can you confirm it’s definitely this Saturday, and what items they’re actually accepting before I pass anything along?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Yes, it’s definitely this Saturday; they’re taking small appliances, lamps, bikes, clothing repairs, and basic electronics—nothing hazardous or too large to carry.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Thanks, Quinn—that’s the confirmation I needed. I’ll pass along that it’s this Saturday and they’re accepting small carryable repairs, with no hazardous or oversized items.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Hi Uli, I’m still piecing together the repair drive details—have you heard any confirmed updates on the date or what repairs they’re accepting?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Hi Nell — I haven’t heard a confirmed date yet, only that Sam may have the latest flyers. I’m mostly asking around about tool kits, but I can pass along anything solid if I hear it.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Uli — I’ll check with Sam about the flyers and keep holding off on sharing anything until the date and repair list are confirmed.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’m helping keep the repair drive moving, but Cleo’s still confirming the time and what supplies we need. Once I get the details, I’ll pass them along to everyone.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Vik. Send me Cleo’s confirmed time and supply list when you have it, and I’ll help update Rosa and Opal.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Will do, Leo — as soon as Cleo confirms the time and supply list, I’ll send it your way so you can update Rosa and Opal.
